recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-close-up portrait of a smiling man with textured, curly hair, set against a mottled blue studio backdrop. The lighting is soft and diffused, creating a hazy, romanticized atmosphere typical of late 1970s commercial photography, framed by a thin horizontal rule at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a square frame
Soft-focus edges blending subject into the background
Linear typographic header cutting across the top third
High-key facial lighting contrasting with deep blue shadows
coreInvariants: Horizontal white rule line integrated with text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered bust-up portrait, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and smile, positioned in the upper-center quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top horizontal rule down to the subject's face, then following the crossed arms at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample blue space surrounding the head and shoulders to emphasize the portrait.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and golden-brown hair
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the background with high value in the center to create a glow effect.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text is a slanted, connected script with thick-to-thin transitions
Secondary text is a wide-tracked, geometric sans-serif
The script text is bisected or underlined by a continuous horizontal rule
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders are shortened to fit within the horizontal rule line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between fluid, organic script and rigid, wide-spaced geometric sans.

preserve: Integration of script with the line

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, wide-tracked subtitle style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus studio portrait of a man with 1970s curly hair and a light blue button-down shirt, arms crossed, smiling warmly. The background is a mottled, airbrushed blue gradient. Apply a slight hazy glow to the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thin white horizontal rule across the top third. Place a bold white script title centered so it rests on the line. Below that, place a subtitle in wide-tracked, small uppercase white sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting soft-focus and hazy?
Is the subtitle tracking extremely wide?
Does the script text interact with the horizontal line?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the image has a square aspect ratio
Check that the text is legible against the blue background
Verify the 'glow' effect is present on the subject's skin
Confirm the horizontal line is perfectly straight
recipe.reuseFormula: Square frame + Mottled Blue Backdrop + Soft-Focus Portrait + Horizontal Rule + Script/Sans Pairing = 70s Soft-Rock Aesthetic.
